# Resolved Code Ref

## Summary
A code ref whose `module` has been resolved to an absolute URL — the form
the index reports and cross-realm consumers require. `AbsoluteCodeRefField`
carries exactly this.

## Invariants
- Search-result `ref.module` values are always absolute, even when the
  underlying Spec stored a relative ref — resolution happens at indexing.
- Comparing refs across realms must compare resolved forms; relative forms
  are only meaningful with their base document.

## Example
The table Spec (`Spec/table`) demonstrates this: it stores `ref.module:
"../table"`, which the search index reports as
`https://realms-staging.stack.cards/richard.tan1/boxel-software-matrix-layer/table`.

## Module
`runtime-common/code-ref.ts`; carrier field:
`https://cardstack.com/base/code-ref` — export `AbsoluteCodeRefField`.
